Eastern Washington Somewhere. I used a Canon F1 and Kodak Tri-X film to make this photograph. #landscape #canonf1 #kodaktrix400 #roadtrip #35mmfilm

“When the seagulls follow the trawler, it is because they think sardines will be thrown into the sea.” — Eric Cantona, 1995. I used a Canon QL17 GIII and Arista EDU 400 film to make this photograph. #gull #beach #birds #canonql17giii #35mmfilm

The Dorothy Chandler Pavilion. Los Angeles. I acquired a Vivitar PN2011 years ago. I flipped the lens around. It gave me some interesting (to me) images, like this one. I used Kodak Gold 400 film to make this photo. #architecture #dorothychandlerpavilion #toycameraphotography #flippedlens #35mmphoto
Summer. I used a Canon F1 with expired Kodak Plus X film and a red filter to make this photograph. #canonf1 #kodakplusx125 #expiredfilmgallery #35mmfilm #streetphotographersmagazine
Behold the Head of Security. I used a Canon F1 and Legacy Pro 400 film to make this photograph. #portrait #35mmfilm #canonf1 #blackandwhite #filmisnotdead

“Get me a beer,…NOW!!!” A quote from one of my brother’s characters (see the work of booda_von_boodstein). In a brewery I somewhere. Can’t remember which brewery. I used Kodak Tri-X film and, I think, an Olympus XA3 to make this photograph. #olympusxa3 #kodaktrix400 #blackandwhite #blur #35mmfilm

The ticketing lobby at Los Angeles Union Station. Imagine the great days of rail travel and the hordes of people queueing at the long ticketing counter on the right. I used a Mamiya 7 and Portra 160 film to make this photo. #mamiya7 #portra160 #unionstationla #architecturephotography #mediumformat

Commuter. Union station. Los Angeles, California. I used a Mamiya 7 and Kodak Portra 160 film to make this photograph. #mamiya7 #portra160 #mediumformatfilm #unionstationla #streetphotographersmagazine

LACMA. Couldn’t believe my eyes. All angles & greens. Even the lady’s dress and posture. Snapped the picture quick. No time to fiddle with exposure lest the moment fade. I used a Mamiya 7 and expired Portra 800 to make this photograph. #lacma #mamiya7 #kodakportra800 #expiredfilm #mediumformatfilm
Me and George at LACMA some years ago. I used a Mamiya 7 and expired Kodak Portra 800 film to make this photograph. #lacma #mamiya7 #portra800 #expiredfilm #mediumformatfilm
Lane Splitter. 405 southbound. Long Beach, California. I used an Olympus XA3 and expired Fuji 200 film to make this photograph. #lanesplitter #olympusxa3 #35mmfilm #traffic #filmisnotdead

Waiting in the Wings. Ballet Etudes Nutcracker. Maybe 2011 or so. I used an Olympus XA and Fuji Neopan 400 film to make this photograph. The camera shake was worth it for the light, I think. #balletetudeshb #fujineopan400 #dancer #olympusxa #35mmfilm
Dancers Exiting A Black Box Theater. I used an Olympus XA and Arista EDU 400 film to make this photograph. #blackboxtheatre #exit #35mmfilm #olympusxa #motionblur

“I don’t do windows!” On the ferry to Port Townsend. I used an Olympus OM2n and Rollei Retro 400s film to make this photograph. #filmphotography #rolleiretro400s #olympusom2n #ferryboat #filmisnotdead

On the ferry to Friday Harbor. I used an Olympus OM2n  with Rollei Infrared film and a number 29 red filter on an Olympus Zuiko 30-70 zoom lens. #rolleiinfrared #ferryboat #blackandwhite #35mmfilm #filmisnotdead

Photobombed by an Oysterman! He popped out of nowhere like a Jack-in-the-box. His timing was impeccable and he made a boring photograph interesting. :-). I used an Olympus OM2n and Rollei Retro 400s film to make this photograph. #rolleiretro400s #porttownsend #olympusom2n #photobomb #35mm

Surf City. I used an Olympus OM2n and Arista EDU 400 film to make this photograph. #surfcityusa #huntingtonbeach #35mm #blackandwhite #filmphotography

My brother Stewart, AKA artist S.K. Moore. On the veranda of his home. I used a Canon F1 and Kodak Tri-X. I guessed at the exposure while I steadied the camera on a railing. Scenes of Skagit Bay. Well I’ve gone and done it again; I’ve accidentally shot a roll of film with the camera set on “bulb” mode! I used a Holga 120N (wish I could remember to not have it set to B!) and Ilford HP5 film. #blackandwhite #toycamera #holga #mediumformat #skagitbay
